images/00-Mermaid-Symfony.webp.title: Mermaid Symphony
images/00-Mermaid-Symfony.webp.alt: Smiling mermaid with long blue dreadlocks and a red-gold tail swims through bright blue water among bubbles
images/00-Mermaid-Symfony.webp.tooltip: She just spotted someone above the surface and cannot hide how pleased she is.
images/00-Mermaid-Symfony.webp.description: Her hair gave me the most trouble: heavy dark-blue locks that float up and sideways, each one needing its own curve. I painted her mid-laugh with both hands at her ears, as if she just heard something funny from above. Sunlight comes in from the top right and turns the water pale turquoise. The far tail and the little fish are painted thin and almost clear to push them back into the water.
images/00-Mermaid-Symfony.webp.craft: Digital painting · soft gradients · light from top right · translucent distant forms

images/02_Flying.webp.title: Flying
images/02_Flying.webp.alt: Woman in a red and white space suit rises on a jet of ice above a sea of clouds, looking up into a starry column of light
images/02_Flying.webp.tooltip: A pilot lifted off her platform by a burst of ice, eyes fixed on something far above.
images/02_Flying.webp.description: I painted her rising on a plume of ice crystals, face turned up to the shaft of light above. Red and white suit, brown leather straps, all set against cold purple and navy. The clouds below are flat cream shapes with clean comic outlines, not soft airbrush. Going tall let me stretch the climb from her boots all the way up to the stars.
images/02_Flying.webp.craft: Digital illustration · inked outlines · warm suit on cold blues · tall vertical format

images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.title: The Book Truce
images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.alt: Bearded man in a white turban and cloak raises a book to the sky on a cliff edge, swords and shields laid at his feet
images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.tooltip: Weapons dropped at his feet, he holds up a book instead.
images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.project: Personal project · North African historical scene
images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.description: My starting point was the pile at his feet: curved swords, shields and a spear dropped on the rock. Then I gave him a book to raise instead, with light breaking through the clouds behind it. I painted the torn white edges of his cloak to catch that light. Far below, a crowd on the plain stays a soft, blurred haze.
images/03_The_Book_Truce.webp.craft: Digital painting · god rays · white cloth against blue sky · low viewpoint

images/04_Berber_Beauty_.webp.title: Berber Beauty
images/04_Berber_Beauty_.webp.alt: Amazigh woman in a striped headwrap with a silver forehead disc, drop earrings and facial tattoos on crimson
images/04_Berber_Beauty_.webp.tooltip: A steady gaze framed by silver, red stones and traditional Amazigh markings.
images/04_Berber_Beauty_.webp.description: Lighting her face from the left, I painted the striped headwrap loose and saved the crispest edges for the silver. The forehead disc with red stones, the dangling earrings and the thin geometric tattoos on chin and chest all come from traditional Amazigh dress. Her dark braids end in white wool tufts at the shoulders. The crimson strokes behind her stay visible instead of being smoothed out.
images/04_Berber_Beauty_.webp.craft: Digital painting · silver jewelry detail · red and orange palette · visible brushwork

images/05_Salim_go_to_fish_.webp.title: Salim Goes Fishing
images/05_Salim_go_to_fish_.webp.alt: Boy bends a fishing rod as a girl in a blue dress braces in a rowboat on clear turquoise water, huge fish below
images/05_Salim_go_to_fish_.webp.tooltip: Salim hooks something far bigger than the boat, and his friend is already bracing.
images/05_Salim_go_to_fish_.webp.description: Salim has hooked something bigger than the boat, and the whole hull leans with him. I drew the two kids with loose line and flat color, then painted the water softer around them: clear turquoise, light patterns on the sandy floor, small fish drifting past. A plastic bottle sinks near the rocks. Looking straight down made the water the real subject.
images/05_Salim_go_to_fish_.webp.craft: Digital illustration · top-down view · water light patterns · loose line, flat color

images/06_The_Desert_Princess.webp.title: The Desert Princess
images/06_The_Desert_Princess.webp.alt: Young woman with braided hair, blue face paint, a peacock feather earring and an orange scarf before desert dunes
images/06_The_Desert_Princess.webp.tooltip: Blue paint against orange sand, with one peacock feather for a surprise.
images/06_The_Desert_Princess.webp.description: Blue markings on warm brown skin against orange dunes was the plan from the first sketch. The face paint curves around her eyes and runs down her neck, and a single peacock-feather earring slips one note of green into all that blue and ochre. Half her hair is cornrows, half thick twists. I blurred the sand behind her and kept the hair texture sharp.
images/06_The_Desert_Princess.webp.craft: Digital painting · complementary blue and orange · blurred dunes · textured hair

images/07_Above-the-clouds.webp.title: Above the Clouds
images/07_Above-the-clouds.webp.alt: Red-haired mermaid in a yellow top rises from a white cloud sea holding a tiny winged flyer, floating islands behind
images/07_Above-the-clouds.webp.tooltip: A mermaid in a sea of cloud, wondering where the water went.
images/07_Above-the-clouds.webp.description: Take a mermaid out of the ocean and put her in a sea of cloud, and she has every reason to look puzzled. Her tail lies detached on the cloud floor while she holds up a small winged flyer, water still pouring off it. Two floating islands with trees and a tower hang in the distance. I left the cloud almost blank white under her red hair and yellow top.
images/07_Above-the-clouds.webp.craft: Digital painting · saturated blue sky · white cloud plane · red hair as focal point

images/08_Trapped.webp.title: Trapped
images/08_Trapped.webp.alt: Girl with flying dark hair seen from above, wrapped in a giant parchment sheet of Arabic calligraphy in a library
images/08_Trapped.webp.tooltip: Calligraphy loops around her like rope and the library falls away beneath her.
images/08_Trapped.webp.project: Personal project · calligraphy and books illustration
images/08_Trapped.webp.description: The camera looks straight down on her as she falls past the shelves. A huge sheet of paper has wrapped her torso, and black Arabic calligraphy coils off it like rope around her arms and legs. I pushed the perspective hard so the bookcases tilt away, and lit her face from below with the pale parchment.
images/08_Trapped.webp.craft: Digital painting · top-down perspective · calligraphy as ropes · dark blue palette

images/09_berber_soldier.webp.title: Berber Soldier
images/09_berber_soldier.webp.alt: Painted Amazigh warrior in a white turban and red sash swings a curved sword, round shield on his back, desert behind
images/09_berber_soldier.webp.tooltip: Caught a split second before the strike, with the dust still hanging in the air.
images/09_berber_soldier.webp.description: He is a guard from the southern caravans, the kind of man who has fought more sandstorms than people. I built the pose to read from far away: everything leans into the sword arm and the sash streams the other way. Behind him I dragged a few dry-brush strokes of sky and sand and left it at that, letting the flying red sash carry the shot.
images/09_berber_soldier.webp.craft: Digital painting · gesture-first pose · red against blue · dry-brush background

images/10_A-Great-Sight.webp.title: A Great Sight
images/10_A-Great-Sight.webp.alt: Blonde girl in a yellow heart T-shirt and flared jeans shades her eyes on a curved stone balcony above the sea
images/10_A-Great-Sight.webp.tooltip: Hand over her brow, mouth open, she has just seen something enormous out at sea.
images/10_A-Great-Sight.webp.description: Mouth open, one hand shading her brow from the glare, she has just spotted something huge out past the frame. I pitched the camera high above the balcony and swept the curved stone railing around her in a tight spiral. Tiny sailboats on the water set the scale. Flared jeans and a heart on her shirt keep her casual.
images/10_A-Great-Sight.webp.craft: Digital illustration · high camera angle · curved railing as leading line · inked outlines

images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.title: Mecha in the Hangar
images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.alt: White and silver mecha with pointed shoulder blades and a long rifle stands on a lit platform in a dim industrial hangar
images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.tooltip: A pale mecha waiting in the dark, lit from every side by sparks of white light.
images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.project: Environment and mecha concept · hangar scene
images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.description: White plating separates the mecha from the tangle of dark steel pipes and hanging cables around it. I scattered a few lens flares near the rifle and feet and let thin beams glance off them, as if the machine were powering up. A keypad on a coiled cord sits in the foreground, a small prop that makes the hangar feel used.
images/11_Mecha_14_Jewlery.webp.craft: Digital painting · low-key lighting · lens flares · cluttered foreground for depth

images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.title: Magnitude Main Menu
images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.alt: Game menu splash screen with a stubbled man in a dark suit aiming a pistol, a night city behind and the title Magnitude
images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.tooltip: A suit, a pistol and a night skyline, with the title card waiting on a button press.
images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.project: Game UI · main menu splash mockup
images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.description: On a menu screen the painting shares space with a title, so I put him hard left and left the right side open for lettering. He wears a loosened tie and black gloves and holds his pistol at chest height. The skyline behind is out of focus in blue and orange lights. Slim retro type leaves plenty of dark sky around his gun hand.
images/12_MainMenu-Splash.webp.craft: Digital painting · game title layout · shallow depth of field · cool night palette

images/13_Massacre-of-the-Vikings.webp.title: Massacre of the Vikings
images/13_Massacre-of-the-Vikings.webp.alt: Bearded Viking holds an arrow-struck shield on a longship as a warrior leaps in with an axe, burning ships behind
images/13_Massacre-of-the-Vikings.webp.tooltip: Arrows in his shield, flames across the water, and a leaping axeman already on top of him.
images/13_Massacre-of-the-Vikings.webp.description: An old Viking crouches under a shield stuck with three arrows while a man in red leaps across from the next boat, axe overhead. I used inked lines and flat warm color to keep the action readable through the smoke. Burning longships fill the back and white spray frames the front. Browns and smoky oranges hold the fleet together, and his red tunic punches through on the right.
images/13_Massacre-of-the-Vikings.webp.craft: Digital illustration · inked line · warm brown palette · smoke and splash shapes

images/14_Smooth-Woman.webp.title: Gold and Violet Gaze
images/14_Smooth-Woman.webp.alt: Portrait of a dark-skinned warrior woman with black hair, purple face paint, a gold forehead mark and a fur collar
images/14_Smooth-Woman.webp.tooltip: Gold down the nose, violet at the eyes, and a stare that does not blink.
images/14_Smooth-Woman.webp.description: I scrubbed in her dark hair and fur collar with rough, dry strokes and blended the skin smooth, leaving her face calm amid the texture. A gold bar runs from forehead to nose and another marks her chin, with violet strokes by the brows, eyes and lips. The hard stare matters more here than a pretty face.
images/14_Smooth-Woman.webp.craft: Digital painting · gold and purple accents · rough brushwork around smooth skin

images/15_Sauvetage-de-la-Baleine.webp.title: Whale Rescue
images/15_Sauvetage-de-la-Baleine.webp.alt: Spaceship cockpit view of an astronaut and a whale drifting among asteroids, holograms with Arabic text in front
images/15_Sauvetage-de-la-Baleine.webp.tooltip: The pilot's view of a whale drifting through an asteroid field, with a spacewalker nearby.
images/15_Sauvetage-de-la-Baleine.webp.description: The cockpit is full of small things: floating blue holograms, Arabic text on the screens, a laptop, loose papers, a card pinned in the corner. Outside, an astronaut on a tether and a gray whale drift between cratered rocks. I painted the rocks in cold slate blues against the cyan glow of the instruments.
images/15_Sauvetage-de-la-Baleine.webp.craft: Digital illustration · cockpit framing · blue hologram glow · cratered asteroid shapes

images/16_Calligraphy-Ship.webp.title: Calligraphy Ship
images/16_Calligraphy-Ship.webp.alt: White and blue spaceship with swept fins flies above a cloud-covered blue planet against a dark red nebula
images/16_Calligraphy-Ship.webp.tooltip: Fins swept like ink strokes, a cruiser banks silently above a clouded world.
images/16_Calligraphy-Ship.webp.description: The hull curves like pen strokes, which is where the name came from: long swept fins that look like a brush lifting off the page. I painted it white with blue panels to cut across the crimson and violet nebula. Below, the planet is mostly soft cloud with a bright atmosphere edge.
images/16_Calligraphy-Ship.webp.craft: Digital painting · white hull with blue panels · red nebula behind · curved planet horizon

images/17-Check-My-Armor.webp.title: Gold Armor in the Rubble
images/17-Check-My-Armor.webp.alt: Helmeted soldier in gold and brown armor with a cape and a blocky rifle points to the side amid rubble and dust
images/17-Check-My-Armor.webp.tooltip: Gold armor in a gray ruin, one arm pointing the way forward.
images/17-Check-My-Armor.webp.description: Gold plates over dark brown padding, a cape, a clear visor and a squat modern rifle: I mixed classical armor with something closer to a soldier of the future. She points off to the side as if sending someone ahead. Gray smoke and scattered rock shapes fill the ground, with her legs and boots left clean against it.
images/17-Check-My-Armor.webp.craft: Digital painting · gold on brown against gray · soft dust · clear silhouette

images/18_Sketch-black-man-with-glasses-.title: Sphera Athlete
images/18_Sketch-black-man-with-glasses-.alt: Bald man with a goatee and sunglasses touches his temple, in dark shorts and tee, gym bag in hand, on black
images/18_Sketch-black-man-with-glasses-.tooltip: An easygoing athlete in dark glasses, signing off with two fingers at his temple.
images/18_Sketch-black-man-with-glasses-.description: Two fingers at the temple, gym bag in hand, dark glasses on: I built the whole poster around an easy, unhurried stance. His navy kit carries white bands at waist, knees and sleeves against the black ground. The orange Sphera SportsWear basketball logo sits bottom right, and I brushed the shading fast and soft.
images/18_Sketch-black-man-with-glasses-.craft: Digital painting · dark outfit on black · white trim accents · orange logo

characters/images/01_Forgotten_Soldier.w.title: Forgotten Soldier
characters/images/01_Forgotten_Soldier.w.alt: Soldier in blue armor with a large rifle looks up from a foxhole surrounded by sandbags, spent shells and purple smoke
characters/images/01_Forgotten_Soldier.w.tooltip: Dug in with sandbags, brass and smoke piled around him, he is still watching the sky.
characters/images/01_Forgotten_Soldier.w.description: Nobody is coming for him, and I built the picture around that. I looked down into his foxhole so he feels small, ringed by sandbags, shell casings, a broken crate and rolled smoke. Everything is dyed violet, which flattens the scene into one cold mood. I hatched the smoke by hand, so it reads like ink rather than fog.
characters/images/01_Forgotten_Soldier.w.craft: Digital illustration · high camera angle · violet monochrome · hand-hatched smoke

characters/images/03_Andromache-Scylla-C.title: Andromache the Scylla
characters/images/03_Andromache-Scylla-C.alt: Scylla character sheet: woman raising a glowing caduceus staff above six hound heads and red tentacles, text panel left
characters/images/03_Andromache-Scylla-C.tooltip: Half woman, half hound pack on a nest of tentacles, and a staff that glows like a flare.
characters/images/03_Andromache-Scylla-C.description: The sheet text calls her Andromache, Scylla of Scheria, and describes a centaur of sorts. I drew that literally: a woman's torso on top, six black hound heads at her waist and a coil of crimson tentacles below. Warm light from her raised staff catches her face and glints along the hounds' bared teeth. Fire and smoke behind her give the monster somewhere to stand.
characters/images/03_Andromache-Scylla-C.craft: Digital illustration · character sheet layout · glowing staff · crimson against dark

characters/images/04_Fighting_The_Good_F.title: Fighting the Good Fight
characters/images/04_Fighting_The_Good_F.alt: Armored knight in a spiked helmet with a drawn curved sword and a torn red banner stands on rocks in a cloud of dust
characters/images/04_Fighting_The_Good_F.tooltip: A battered knight on a rock, banner torn and sword out, with the dust still settling.
characters/images/04_Fighting_The_Good_F.description: He holds the rock above the fighting with his sword already drawn. The armor is heavy and dented, the red cloth under it ragged, like he came through something bad. I left the banner emblem abstract so he belongs to no single army. Thick rounded outlines of dust crowd around him and frame his spiked helmet.
characters/images/04_Fighting_The_Good_F.craft: Digital illustration · inked line · muted sand and steel palette · red accents

characters/images/05_Cartoon-Soldier-.we.title: Cartoon Soldier
characters/images/05_Cartoon-Soldier-.we.alt: Short stylized soldier in a plumed helmet and turban raises a curved sword on a rock above clouds, shield on his arm
characters/images/05_Cartoon-Soldier-.we.tooltip: The smallest soldier on the mountain, and the one holding his sword highest.
characters/images/05_Cartoon-Soldier-.we.description: Short legs, big chin, very serious face. I still gave him the full kit: plumed helmet, turban, patterned shield, gold-trimmed armor and a curved sword held high. He stands on a lone rock above a flat sea of cloud at dawn, which makes him look taller than he is. Pastel light behind him keeps the humor warm.
characters/images/05_Cartoon-Soldier-.we.craft: Digital painting · exaggerated proportions · pastel dawn sky · soft cloud sea

characters/images/06_The_Turkish-Bandit..title: The Turkish Bandit
characters/images/06_The_Turkish-Bandit..alt: Mustachioed bandit in a headscarf and fur vest swings a curved sword and levels a long bayonet rifle across a sandy desert
characters/images/06_The_Turkish-Bandit..tooltip: The Scoundrel, caught mid-lunge with a sword in one hand and a bayonet in the other.
characters/images/06_The_Turkish-Bandit..description: His sheet label reads The Scoundrel, and he plays the part: big mustache, bulging eyes, sword up, rifle thrust forward. I aimed for dangerous and slightly ridiculous in one pose. His body is a stack of round shapes: the fur vest, the red baggy trousers, the brass studs. A small head study in the corner shows the expression alone.
characters/images/06_The_Turkish-Bandit..craft: Digital painting · exaggerated pose · desert palette · face study inset

characters/images/07_Standing_Guard.webp.title: Standing Guard
characters/images/07_Standing_Guard.webp.alt: Muscular guard in a gold helmet, breastplate and greaves holds three spears and a short sword in front of a red round shield
characters/images/07_Standing_Guard.webp.tooltip: Three spears in one fist and a sword in the other, he stands guard with a tired face.
characters/images/07_Standing_Guard.webp.description: He looks tired but not beaten. Gold armor pieces sit over dark leather and a torn red kilt, with a skull on his belt buckle. Three spears are gathered in one fist, the sword hangs low, and a crimson shield sits behind him like a halo. I gave him a plain gray ground and a simple shadow.
characters/images/07_Standing_Guard.webp.craft: Digital illustration · gold and crimson palette · full-body pose · plain backdrop

characters/images/08_Sora_Character_Desi.title: Sora
characters/images/08_Sora_Character_Desi.alt: Hooded young traveler in a tan tunic with red chevron patterns, loose trousers and sandals, one hand held out
characters/images/08_Sora_Character_Desi.tooltip: A hooded traveler offers an open hand to whoever he meets on the road.
characters/images/08_Sora_Character_Desi.description: Sora looks like a traveler to me, so I dressed him for the road: a hood, a layered tunic, a scarf fading from blue to red, baggy trousers, rope sandals. The red chevrons on sleeves and tunic repeat across the outfit and tie it together. His open hand and faint smile make him approachable. I set him on clean white with a soft shadow so every layer of the costume reads.
characters/images/08_Sora_Character_Desi.craft: Digital painting · full-body design sheet · repeated red chevron motif · white backdrop

characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..title: Sci-Fi Battuta
characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..alt: Man with glasses in a tan and purple suit rides a blue hover bike loaded with crates across a grassy hill under a huge planet
characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..tooltip: A traveler pauses on a green hilltop to point out the far horizon from his hover bike.
characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..project: Character and vehicle concept · sci-fi traveler
characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..description: Battuta makes me think of a traveler, so I made him one: a bike with big cargo boxes and a pack, parked on a hillside while he points at something far off. A huge pale planet rises over the hills and mist fills the valley. Dents, faded paint and lettering on the hull give the bike a long-haul history.
characters/images/09_Sci-Battuta-Sketch..craft: Digital painting · worn hover bike · teal and green palette · atmospheric haze

characters/images/10_The-Fool-bandit.web.title: The Fool
characters/images/10_The-Fool-bandit.web.alt: Grinning heavy bandit with an eyepatch swings an oversized stone hammer on sand dunes, label Blockhead
characters/images/10_The-Fool-bandit.web.tooltip: Blockhead swings a hammer as big as his own head and thoroughly enjoys it.
characters/images/10_The-Fool-bandit.web.description: Blockhead is the name on the sheet, and the hammer is the joke: a stone cube nearly the size of his head. He is wide, grinning and braced for the swing, with an eyepatch, rings on his fingers and rag-stuffed sandals. I painted the sand in soft ripples to keep the ground quiet. A purple vest and magenta pants add color to a beige desert.
characters/images/10_The-Fool-bandit.web.craft: Digital painting · exaggerated proportions · purple and magenta on sand · dune ripples

characters/images/11_Mecha-Bike-12.webp.title: Lamp-Headed Robot
characters/images/11_Mecha-Bike-12.webp.alt: Slim gray robot with blue and yellow panels, antennae and a glowing head lamp stands on a plain floor before a gray wall
characters/images/11_Mecha-Bike-12.webp.tooltip: A lamp-headed machine stands alone in an empty room, one hand blurred as if it just moved.
characters/images/11_Mecha-Bike-12.webp.description: A thin mechanical frame of tubes, cables and a few yellow and blue panels, with antennae sprouting from the shoulders and a lamp for a head. I put him in an empty gray room to concentrate on silhouette and joints. One arm is longer than the other to break the symmetry. A little transparency around the hands hints at movement.
characters/images/11_Mecha-Bike-12.webp.craft: Digital painting over line · gray room · blue and yellow accents · silhouette study

characters/images/12_Mecha-Bike-11.webp.title: Mecha Leap Sketch
characters/images/12_Mecha-Bike-11.webp.alt: Pencil-style sketch of a large mech leaping with a rifle and a long blade on its back, a tiny human figure beside it
characters/images/12_Mecha-Bike-11.webp.tooltip: A mech mid-leap towers over a tiny human figure in the corner.
characters/images/12_Mecha-Bike-11.webp.description: This is a working sketch and I left it rough: a heavy mech leaps with a rifle raised and a long sword strapped across its back. Thick leg pistons and a tangle of tubes around the torso give it weight. Down in the lower left I drew a tiny human figure to show the size of the thing. Light gray marker shading separates the forms without committing to color.
characters/images/12_Mecha-Bike-11.webp.craft: Digital sketch · gray tone shading · scale figure · loose line work

characters/images/13_Head-Chara-Design-..title: Head Study
characters/images/13_Head-Chara-Design-..alt: Painted portrait of a young man with short black hair and a stern, tired look against loose gray brush strokes
characters/images/13_Head-Chara-Design-..tooltip: Heavy lids and a set jaw on a man who has run out of patience.
characters/images/13_Head-Chara-Design-..description: Only the face is finished here, worn down like a man at the end of a long week. I blocked it in with broad strokes of warm brown skin against a flat gray mass and a dark ground. The eyes are half closed and the mouth pulled down. Below the chin the shoulders dissolve into the gray beside a small number.
characters/images/13_Head-Chara-Design-..craft: Digital painting · limited palette · broad brush strokes · dissolving edges

characters/images/14_Fuhreeg-Character-D.title: Fuhreeg
characters/images/14_Fuhreeg-Character-D.alt: Green-faced man in a long black coat aims a pistol, seen from below in heavy rain, red lines and High Voltage signs
characters/images/14_Fuhreeg-Character-D.tooltip: Fuhreeg looks down from a catwalk through the rain, pistol low and grin wide.
characters/images/14_Fuhreeg-Character-D.description: Fuhreeg is a green-skinned gunman in a long black coat, and in this shot he owns the walkway above you. I drew him from below so the coat spreads like a cape, and painted the rain as hard white streaks. Red lines and industrial signs, including a High Voltage warning, run up toward the ceiling. Against all that dark cloth and red, his green face cuts straight through the rain.
characters/images/14_Fuhreeg-Character-D.craft: Digital painting · worm's-eye view · rain streaks · red lines vs green face

characters/images/15_Nessus-Character-De.title: Nessus
characters/images/15_Nessus-Character-De.alt: Satyr archer with red hair and beard, curved horns and goat legs draws a skull-topped bow beside a rock, with a text panel
characters/images/15_Nessus-Character-De.tooltip: Nessus draws his bow and claims to be the world's best archer, musician and lover.
characters/images/15_Nessus-Character-De.description: Nessus is a satyr, and the sheet quotes him as the world's best archer, musician and lover, not necessarily in that order. I built him like a pit fighter instead of the lean satyr you would expect. The pose pulls the bow up and back with a skull on the grip as a small joke. Shaggy brown legs balance the bare torso and plant him in the mud.
characters/images/15_Nessus-Character-De.craft: Digital illustration · character sheet layout · brown and red palette · bow-draw pose

characters/images/16_Kairos-Character-De.title: Kairos
characters/images/16_Kairos-Character-De.alt: Young soldier with black hair stands ankle-deep in blue water with a long spear, a round navy and red shield, gold armor
characters/images/16_Kairos-Character-De.tooltip: Kairos wades into shallow water with spear and shield, smiling like he has nothing to prove.
characters/images/16_Kairos-Character-De.description: Kairos looks young and unbothered to me: a small smile, spear in hand, standing easy in the shallows. His armor is gold shoulder guards, greaves with animal faces and a navy shield with a red emblem. The sea is flat blue with a few white ripple lines, and his legs show through the water. Broken red planks float in front of him, a story I left open.
characters/images/16_Kairos-Character-De.craft: Digital illustration · flat blue water · gold armor details · simple ripple lines

characters/images/17_Massacre-of-the-Vik.title: Viking Battle Close-Up
characters/images/17_Massacre-of-the-Vik.alt: Bearded Viking crouches under an arrow-struck shield on a longship while a warrior in red leaps in with an axe, flames behind
characters/images/17_Massacre-of-the-Vik.tooltip: Shield full of arrows, and an axeman leaping in from the next boat.
characters/images/17_Massacre-of-the-Vik.description: I framed the Viking fight tight on the two men. The older one holds his shield overhead with three arrows stuck in it as the attacker jumps across with an axe raised. Cream smoke curls through the right side and burning ships glow far back. Loose ink lines and earth-toned washes let his red garment cut sharp across the smoke.
characters/images/17_Massacre-of-the-Vik.craft: Digital illustration · inked line · warm palette · smoke curls and spray shapes

characters/images/18_Soldat-Saturnien.we.title: Saturnian Soldier
characters/images/18_Soldat-Saturnien.we.alt: Character sheet of a spiky-haired soldier in pink shoulder armor with a hammer and a cannon, plus four head studies
characters/images/18_Soldat-Saturnien.we.tooltip: A cocky grunt with a mohawk swings a hammer one minute and shoulders a cannon the next.
characters/images/18_Soldat-Saturnien.we.description: My notes for this grunt started with the leaping hammer swing, because I needed his attitude before his gear. Then I stood him still with the cannon to work out the pink shoulder plates, the belt and the red sash. Four head studies pin down the mohawk and the visor over one eye from the front and the side. The hammer head is boxy and oversized, which keeps his silhouette clear at small size.
characters/images/18_Soldat-Saturnien.we.craft: Digital painting · turnaround sheet · clean outline · soft color fills

characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.title: Kabyle Girls Drafts
characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.alt: Seven numbered sketches of young women's faces with dark hair, varied expressions and small tattoos, on warm paper
characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.tooltip: Seven young women, seven attitudes, and only one of them smiles back.
characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.project: Personal project · Kabyle girls character drafts
characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.description: Before settling on a design I draw a whole row of faces and see which ones have something to say. Here the forehead marks, the cheek tattoos, a striped headband and purple lipstick each pull a face in a different direction. Number 4 is the friendliest and number 7 the sharpest. I numbered them so I could pick later.
characters/images/19_Kabyl-Girls-Charact.craft: Digital sketching · face exploration · warm paper tone · loose line

characters/images/20_Berber-soldier.webp.title: Berber Soldier
characters/images/20_Berber-soldier.webp.alt: Painted Berber warrior in white turban and red sash swinging a curved sword, round shield on back, desert behind
characters/images/20_Berber-soldier.webp.tooltip: Frozen in the middle of a swing, with sand still hanging in the air behind him.
characters/images/20_Berber-soldier.webp.description: He is a fighter from the desert caravans, painted at the moment his weight shifts into the strike. I made the sword arm and the flying red sash travel in opposite directions, which gives the pose a clear read from across a room. Under his boots I dragged dry brush in ochre and white dust. Red cloth against blue sky is the whole color plan.
characters/images/20_Berber-soldier.webp.craft: Digital painting · gesture-first pose · red against blue · dry-brush ground

characters/images/21_Time-For-Sport.webp.title: Time for Sport
characters/images/21_Time-For-Sport.webp.alt: Pencil-style sketch of a smiling young woman in a fur-collared tunic carrying a long net-headed stick on her shoulder
characters/images/21_Time-For-Sport.webp.tooltip: She is off to play, and she already looks like she is winning.
characters/images/21_Time-For-Sport.webp.description: A woman heads to a game with a long net-headed stick over her shoulder, like she does this every week. The stick crosses the whole page, and I gave her a slightly smug grin to match. Most of my time went into the fur collar and the curling patterns on her pocketed apron. Graphite tones were enough here, and I left the warm paper alone.
characters/images/21_Time-For-Sport.webp.craft: Digital graphite sketch · confident stance · warm paper · detailed costume

characters/images/22_Flying-Upward.webp.title: Flying Upward
characters/images/22_Flying-Upward.webp.alt: Astronaut woman in a red and white suit rising from a glowing crystal pedestal above clouds under a starry sky
characters/images/22_Flying-Upward.webp.tooltip: One breath before she leaves the ground, and the clouds are already below her.
characters/images/22_Flying-Upward.webp.description: Everything in this tall frame points up: her chin, her arms hanging loose at her sides, the column of light falling from the top edge. I inked the outlines comic-style over a flat midnight blue. The suit is red and white with brown straps. Below her boots the clouds are simple stacked cream shapes, which keeps the scale clear and the mood quiet.
characters/images/22_Flying-Upward.webp.craft: Digital illustration · inked outlines · vertical composition · red on deep blue

characters/images/23_I-wanna-Help.webp.title: Barefoot on the Ridge
characters/images/23_I-wanna-Help.webp.alt: Barefoot Kabyle girl in a red dress and silver jewelry holding a long flintlock rifle on a rocky ridge, smoke behind
characters/images/23_I-wanna-Help.webp.tooltip: She is small, the rifle is long, and the smoke on the plain says why she is there.
characters/images/23_I-wanna-Help.webp.description: A girl in traditional red stands on a rock holding a rifle nearly as long as she is tall. Far behind her, small puffs of smoke mark a battle she can only watch. I took my time with the silver brooches and the necklace, since they are the proudest part of the outfit. The ridge and the distant peaks are blocked in with broad, simple shapes.
characters/images/23_I-wanna-Help.webp.craft: Digital painting · red dress on blue sky · silver jewelry detail · simple landscape

characters/images/24_Flaming-Stare-Chara.title: Flaming Stare
characters/images/24_Flaming-Stare-Chara.alt: Girl with long red hair blowing sideways, blue shirt and tan trousers, seen from behind glaring over her shoulder
characters/images/24_Flaming-Stare-Chara.tooltip: She turned around with her teeth clenched, and the hair is still catching up.
characters/images/24_Flaming-Stare-Chara.description: The whip of red hair carries the whole motion: it swings wide as she spins and glares back over her shoulder with clenched teeth. I drew her from behind to show the weight sitting in her hips and legs, which a front view would hide. The background is plain warm paper. Her boots are painted almost black to ground the figure.
characters/images/24_Flaming-Stare-Chara.craft: Digital painting · motion in the hair · back view pose · textured warm background

characters/images/25_Makeya-Concept-Art..title: Makeya
characters/images/25_Makeya-Concept-Art..alt: Sci-fi soldier Makeya in gold-trimmed armor, visor helmet and cloak, pistol in one hand, pointing, in foggy ruins
characters/images/25_Makeya-Concept-Art..tooltip: Makeya points the way forward with a pistol in the other hand and ruins all around.
characters/images/25_Makeya-Concept-Art..description: Makeya is a scout in gold-trimmed plates over a dark suit, with a long cloak hanging from the shoulders. I gave the armor dull gold and heavy shapes, because it should look used rather than polished. The free hand points ahead while the pistol hangs low. Grey and white fog fills the ruins, painted loose, and the figure stands clear in the middle.
characters/images/25_Makeya-Concept-Art..craft: Digital painting · gold accents on dark armor · foggy grey ruins · pointing gesture

characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.title: Fuhreeg Reaching Goal
characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.alt: Bald green-skinned character in a dark coat crouching in a corridor corner with a pistol, dust drifting in the light
characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.tooltip: Fuhreeg crouches in a corner with a pistol, watching the light and what might come through it.
characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.project: Personal project · sci-fi story scene · Fuhreeg
characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.description: Fuhreeg is hiding at the corner of a service corridor and glancing back toward the bright side of the frame. A radiation hazard sign is bolted to the pillar behind him, and 0015 is stenciled on the floor. I used cold greys with a pink side light. Flecks of dust cross the frame, which makes the light feel thick.
characters/images/26_Fuhreeg-Reaching-Go.craft: Digital painting · cold greys with pink accent · dust particles · high camera angle

characters/images/27_500_Miles_Away.webp.title: 500 Miles Away
characters/images/27_500_Miles_Away.webp.alt: Watercolor-style sketch of a lone soldier with gas mask, scarf and rifle, loaded with gear, walking across pale desert
characters/images/27_500_Miles_Away.webp.tooltip: A long walk, a lot of gear, and no end of sand in any direction.
characters/images/27_500_Miles_Away.webp.description: One person, one rifle and everything he owns strapped to his body. I drew the bundles bigger than he is to show how far he has already carried them. Footprints trail behind and a small cloud of dust hangs off his heels. Pen line and a few watery washes were enough, and most of the paper stays bare.
characters/images/27_500_Miles_Away.webp.craft: Ink line and watercolor washes · desert palette · wind-blown scarf · open composition

characters/images/28_Cassandra-Character.title: Cassandra
characters/images/28_Cassandra-Character.alt: Warrior woman Cassandra with a braid, bronze greaves and round black shield on sea rocks, waves crashing, text box
characters/images/28_Cassandra-Character.tooltip: Cassandra stands on the sea rocks with her shield up and a grin on her face.
characters/images/28_Cassandra-Character.description: Cassandra, called Cass, is a twenty-eight-year-old fighter with a braid and amber eyes, according to the text box on the card. I put her on a rock with waves exploding behind her, because she should look like she is enjoying the fight. Her round black shield and bronze greaves carry the heavy brushwork. The sea behind her is kept light and flat.
characters/images/28_Cassandra-Character.craft: Digital painting · character card layout · blue sea against bronze armor · splash shapes

characters/images/29_Jarel-Character-Des.title: Jarel
characters/images/29_Jarel-Character-Des.alt: Young man with goggles in a bomber jacket on a round platform, using holographic screens beside a robot arm and tank
characters/images/29_Jarel-Character-Des.tooltip: Jarel works a stack of floating screens while a round lab bot reaches for the canister.
characters/images/29_Jarel-Character-Des.description: Jarel is a technician, and I drew him on a lab platform with floating screens that you can see through as well as read. I limited the palette to grey steel and teal holograms, saving warm color for his face and hands. A small round robot sits against his chest and reaches to the canister with a long arm, like a partner he works beside every day.
characters/images/29_Jarel-Character-Des.craft: Digital illustration · teal holograms on grey · inked outlines · foggy platform base

characters/images/30_The-Fisher.webp.title: The Fisher
characters/images/30_The-Fisher.webp.alt: Cartoon fisherman in yellow shorts grinning, holding a purple fish by the line, a black cat on a stool, sandy beach
characters/images/30_The-Fisher.webp.tooltip: He landed the big catch, though neither the purple fish nor the cat looks convinced.
characters/images/30_The-Fisher.webp.description: Too proud of his catch, this fisherman has a grin that takes up half his face. I had the fish side-eye him from the end of the line while the black cat on the camp stool waits for its cut. Loose shapes and a pale blue ground keep the beach scene light. His skinny legs stretch the grin even wider.
characters/images/30_The-Fisher.webp.craft: Digital painting · cartoon proportions · pale blue background · warm skin vs yellow

characters/images/31_dread-lock-punk-gir.title: Dreadlock Punk Girl
characters/images/31_dread-lock-punk-gir.alt: Portrait of a young woman with short dark locs, blue cheek streaks and a red and blue scarf, on a paper collage
characters/images/31_dread-lock-punk-gir.tooltip: A side glance that says she has heard it all before.
characters/images/31_dread-lock-punk-gir.description: My attention went to her face: the look slides left, and the blue streaks on her cheek follow the same direction. The scarf is only a few fast strokes of red and blue. Behind her I layered rough digital textures of paper, bark and cloth, which gives the portrait something gritty to sit on.
characters/images/31_dread-lock-punk-gir.craft: Digital painting · paper and fabric collage background · loose scarf strokes

characters/images/32_ContreBandier.webp.title: The Mugger
characters/images/32_ContreBandier.webp.alt: Sheet titled The Mugger: angry bearded man in cream turban and red trousers with a long rifle, plus a shouting head
characters/images/32_ContreBandier.webp.tooltip: Hand out, rifle under the arm, and a face that is not asking nicely.
characters/images/32_ContreBandier.webp.description: The sheet has a close-up head on the left, where I pushed the shouting mouth as far as it would go, and the full figure on the right. He stands with one bare foot on a rock and one hand out, asking for your money. The rifle is longer than the man's torso, which makes him funny and dangerous together. I painted the red trousers with a rough, textured brush.
characters/images/32_ContreBandier.webp.craft: Digital painting · caricature proportions · warm red against cream · head and full body

characters/images/33_Queen.webp.title: Queen
characters/images/33_Queen.webp.alt: Pencil portrait of a stern queen with a huge wide-brimmed headpiece, hanging tassels, feather crest and forehead jewel
characters/images/33_Queen.webp.tooltip: The crown is wider than her shoulders, and she looks like she planned it that way.
characters/images/33_Queen.webp.description: A queen who does not smile. The headpiece is the statement: a flat disc with a fringe of little hanging cords, a tall feather crest in the middle and an ornament on her forehead. I drew her face straight on and kept it cool, so the crown could be as wild as it wanted. Pencil lines over a grey mottled background kept everything quiet.
characters/images/33_Queen.webp.craft: Digital pencil drawing · symmetrical composition · grey wash · fine ornament detail

characters/images/34_Character-Design-St.title: Stylized Expressions
characters/images/34_Character-Design-St.alt: Three sketches of a red-haired girl with big blue eyes: a wide smile, a sly grin and an angry shout, on cream paper
characters/images/34_Character-Design-St.tooltip: Same girl, three moods, and the angry one wins.
characters/images/34_Character-Design-St.description: Big blue eyes and the sweep of orange hair stay the same while the mouth and brows change everything. This sheet is where I test how far a face can stretch before it stops being her. The shout at the bottom was the most fun to draw. Pencil lines and a flat teal shirt stay unfinished, as on any working page.
characters/images/34_Character-Design-St.craft: Digital sketching · expression study · flat color over pencil · cream paper texture

characters/images/35_Witness-Before-God..title: Witness Before God
characters/images/35_Witness-Before-God..alt: Man in white cloak and red boots on a cliff edge raising a book to a sky with light rays, weapons at his feet
characters/images/35_Witness-Before-God..tooltip: He puts the weapons down and lifts a book to a sky full of light.
characters/images/35_Witness-Before-God..description: Swords, spears and a round shield lie discarded at his boots while he lifts a single book into the open air. I planted him on a cliff edge and gave the upper half of the canvas to shafts of light from the top left. His ragged white cloak billows toward the raised hand. Far below, the plain is a soft haze of tiny people.
characters/images/35_Witness-Before-God..craft: Digital painting · rays of light · torn white cloak · low horizon with big sky

characters/images/36_Berber-Beauty.webp.title: Berber Beauty
characters/images/36_Berber-Beauty.webp.alt: Young Berber woman with colorful head wrap, silver forehead brooch, earrings and chin tattoos, on a crimson ground
characters/images/36_Berber-Beauty.webp.tooltip: Silver, tattoo lines and a calm half-smile against a deep crimson wall.
characters/images/36_Berber-Beauty.webp.description: The silver jewelry and the tattoo marks on her chin and neck got the same respect as the face. The round brooch on the forehead anchors the whole picture. Her eyes are bright blue against warm skin, and the crimson background pulls the colors of the wrap and the fur trim together. I left the brushstrokes in the red visible.
characters/images/36_Berber-Beauty.webp.craft: Digital painting · silver jewelry detail · crimson background · symmetrical portrait

characters/images/37_blacky-03.webp.title: Blacky Sketch
characters/images/37_blacky-03.webp.alt: Sketch of a girl with short pink hair and large blue eyes smiling with her chin on her folded hands, in a white tank top
characters/images/37_blacky-03.webp.tooltip: A sly smile from a girl who has just thought of something.
characters/images/37_blacky-03.webp.description: This one is all in the eyes and the half-smile. She rests her chin on her folded hands and looks at you as if she is about to say something smart. The pink hair with black streaks gives the head a strong shape in a drawing that is otherwise pale. I left the pencil lines and the colored paper visible, because the sketch looks warmer that way.
characters/images/37_blacky-03.webp.craft: Digital sketch · pencil lines over soft color · pink hair accent · warm paper

characters/images/38_100-Heads-12-16_055.title: Weathered Old Man
characters/images/38_100-Heads-12-16_055.alt: Painted head of an older man with deep wrinkles and a mustache, wrapped in white cloth against a dark background
characters/images/38_100-Heads-12-16_055.tooltip: Every wrinkle on his face is a bad winter that he does not talk about.
characters/images/38_100-Heads-12-16_055.description: A study from my head-drawing practice. The white headcloth is the brightest mass in the frame, which carves the face out of the dark. I chopped in the wrinkles with a few hard strokes instead of blending them smooth. Behind him a few grey patches are enough to hold that steady stare.
characters/images/38_100-Heads-12-16_055.craft: Digital painting · head study · white cloth against black · hard-edged brush

characters/images/39_Crazy-Soldier.webp.title: Crazy Soldier
characters/images/39_Crazy-Soldier.webp.alt: Cartoon soldier in a net-covered green helmet shouting as he fires a six-barrel launcher upward, smoke and shells
characters/images/39_Crazy-Soldier.webp.tooltip: He is shouting at the sky while the shells go up, and one of them nearly hits his own helmet.
characters/images/39_Crazy-Soldier.webp.description: A short, round soldier with a launcher that is heavier than he looks, and he loves every second of it. His body leans back against the recoil and his mouth is wide open. I gave him a net on the helmet, a skull patch on his sleeve and gritty fabric textures so that a funny character still looks like he is wearing real equipment.
characters/images/39_Crazy-Soldier.webp.craft: Digital painting · exaggerated proportions · smoke trail · flat grey background

characters/images/40_Smooth-Princess.web.title: Princess in Violet Paint
characters/images/40_Smooth-Princess.web.alt: Dark-skinned woman with a high loose bun, glowing yellow face marks and violet face paint, in a purple fur wrap
characters/images/40_Smooth-Princess.web.tooltip: Violet paint, a yellow mark on the forehead and eyes that look straight through you.
characters/images/40_Smooth-Princess.web.description: She meets you with a hard stare and bold face markings: a yellow bar down the bridge of her nose and violet strokes under her eyes and on her lips. I gave those marks a faint glow against the warm dark skin. Around the smooth face I roughed in the tangled black and violet hair and the fur at her neck with wide, dry strokes.
characters/images/40_Smooth-Princess.web.craft: Digital painting · glowing face marks · violet and gold accents · expressive loose strokes

characters/images/41_Antique-Warrior-Cha.title: Antique Warrior
characters/images/41_Antique-Warrior-Cha.alt: Ancient warrior in a gold crested helmet and red cloth crouching with sword before a black shield and two spears
characters/images/41_Antique-Warrior-Cha.tooltip: A wide stance, a sword at the ready and a red crest that gives away his rank.
characters/images/41_Antique-Warrior-Cha.description: I built this sheet as a character card layout, so the text boxes on the left are still empty and waiting for a bio. The warrior sits in a low, wide stance with the sword held across his body. Two spears behind him form a V that frames the helmet. Red crest and red cloth carry the color against the pale card.
characters/images/41_Antique-Warrior-Cha.craft: Digital illustration · card layout · gold helmet and red cloth · pale background

characters/images/42_Chibeni-Character-D.title: Chibeni
characters/images/42_Chibeni-Character-D.alt: Grey-bearded old man in blue sci-fi armor marked 513 charging through dunes with an antenna staff, dust rising
characters/images/42_Chibeni-Character-D.tooltip: A grey-bearded veteran charges across the dunes, antenna staff first, scowling the whole way.
characters/images/42_Chibeni-Character-D.description: I gave Chibeni the grey beard and scowl of a man who has crossed this desert plenty of times. His armor is blue to cut against the orange dunes, and the number 513 is on his sleeve. The staff with the antenna on top reads as a tool rather than a weapon. A cloud of dust at his feet gives the pose its speed.
characters/images/42_Chibeni-Character-D.craft: Digital painting · blue armor against orange sand · dust cloud · low camera angle

characters/images/43_Animals-character-d.title: Animal Character Designs
characters/images/43_Animals-character-d.alt: Sheet of ten cartoon animals: iguana, macaw, crocodile, zebra, fox, elephant, leopard cub, scorpion, wolf, rhino
characters/images/43_Animals-character-d.tooltip: Ten animals, ten different shapes, all drawn to be friendly.
characters/images/43_Animals-character-d.description: I drew the animals on one page to check that they feel like the same family. The eyes are big and a little cross-eyed, and every animal has one shape that I exaggerated: the zebra's stripes, the fox's tail, the rhino's horn. A soft, chalky texture ties them together. The scorpion is the smallest, and it is also the one with the most attitude.
characters/images/43_Animals-character-d.craft: Digital painting · soft textured brushes · exaggerated shapes · shared eye style

characters/images/44_Comics-Characters.w.title: Arkyla Characters
characters/images/44_Comics-Characters.w.alt: Sheet titled Arkyla Personnages: five fantasy characters, a hooded hero, a singer and three beast demons, with French text
characters/images/44_Comics-Characters.w.tooltip: A clawed hero, a singer and three demons: the cast of an Arkyla comic idea.
characters/images/44_Comics-Characters.w.description: This is a lineup page for a comic idea called Arkyla, with a short French description under each character: the hero, the singer and three demons. The hooded hero has long claw-like hands, and the toucan demon has a bird's head and wings. I gave each character a separate pale panel to compare silhouettes, proportions and costumes side by side.
characters/images/44_Comics-Characters.w.craft: Digital drawing · character lineup layout · muted palette · French text cards

characters/images/45_Rich_Couple.webp.title: Rich Couple
characters/images/45_Rich_Couple.webp.alt: Unfinished portrait of a red-haired woman in a blue robe beside a bald man in a white robe with a gold hand
characters/images/45_Rich_Couple.webp.tooltip: Gold plates on her forehead, a gold hand on him, and half the canvas still in raw line.
characters/images/45_Rich_Couple.webp.description: The woman is nearly finished, with gold plates on her forehead and chest, while the man is still line work with washes of pink. Stopping halfway lets me test how a finished face sits beside a raw one. His gold glove is painted in full. The carved teal pattern behind them gives the pair a cold, expensive backdrop.
characters/images/45_Rich_Couple.webp.craft: Digital painting · partial rendering · gold against blue and teal · ornamental background

characters/images/46_Etyenn-Character-De.title: Etyenn
characters/images/46_Etyenn-Character-De.alt: Blond young man in an orange jacket with cyber face lines, arms crossed, before a pale panel with gauges, titled Etyenn
characters/images/46_Etyenn-Character-De.tooltip: Etyenn grins with his arms crossed, wearing an orange jacket louder than anything on his HUD.
characters/images/46_Etyenn-Character-De.description: Etyenn is a young man with a bleached cut and a bright orange jacket with the words HALO and INTENSITY printed on it. I wanted his clothes to say more about him than his face. The circuit lines on his cheek are the only hint of tech. The pale interface panels with gauges behind him are quiet, so the jacket reads clearly.
characters/images/46_Etyenn-Character-De.craft: Digital illustration · orange jacket on pale blue-grey · interface graphics · full body

characters/images/47_Diver-Plongeur.webp.title: Diver
characters/images/47_Diver-Plongeur.webp.alt: Diver in a brass helmet with a big backpack and hanging hoses, carrying a heavy yellow case, labeled Uboot Hunter
characters/images/47_Diver-Plongeur.webp.tooltip: A diver on dry land, hoses hanging from above and a heavy case in his hand.
characters/images/47_Diver-Plongeur.webp.description: The sheet carries the name Uboot Hunter, so I treated him as a hunter who works at the bottom of the sea. The brass helmet with the round window and the thick boots with big hinges are the strong shapes. Thin hoses hang from above like strings on a puppet, a detail I liked. Ink line and flat colors keep the many parts readable.
characters/images/47_Diver-Plongeur.webp.craft: Digital drawing · inked outline with flat color · brass and brown palette · hanging hoses

characters/images/48_Daghbagi.webp.title: Daghbagi
characters/images/48_Daghbagi.webp.alt: Mustached man in a hooded desert cloak and wrapped leggings sitting against a metal canister under a purple night sky
characters/images/48_Daghbagi.webp.tooltip: A rest by the fire after a long day, and the night sky does not care.
characters/images/48_Daghbagi.webp.description: He sits on a ruined patch of ground with his arms across his knees and a rifle at his back, looking down at something we cannot see. I drew him from a low angle so his legs and boots are large in the frame. The purple night and a small fire in the debris warm up the shapes. Wrapped cloth leggings and a battered metal canister fit a long trip through harsh country.
characters/images/48_Daghbagi.webp.craft: Digital painting · low angle · purple night sky · warm firelight accents

characters/images/49_Girl-Sci-fi.webp.title: Sci-Fi Girl
characters/images/49_Girl-Sci-fi.webp.alt: Sci-fi girl with curly black hair and a big backpack, arms crossed, in a purple top and dark trousers, blue card layout
characters/images/49_Girl-Sci-fi.webp.tooltip: Arms crossed, backpack on and a look that says she is ready to go.
characters/images/49_Girl-Sci-fi.webp.description: A young explorer in a purple top and baggy dark trousers, with a thigh holster and a bulky backpack. Her curly hair and the face marks make her stand out on the blue card layout. The tag in the corner reads SCIF258203, and the radiation, biohazard and fire icons suggest her job is not safe. I kept her stance firm and the shoes chunky.
characters/images/49_Girl-Sci-fi.webp.craft: Digital painting · blue gradient card layout · purple and navy outfit · full body pose

characters/images/50_Desert-princess.web.title: Desert Princess
characters/images/50_Desert-princess.web.alt: Young woman with braided side locs, blue face paint, a peacock-feather earring and orange scarf, dunes behind her
characters/images/50_Desert-princess.web.tooltip: Blue marks, a peacock feather and a look over her shoulder, with dunes behind.
characters/images/50_Desert-princess.web.description: The peacock feather earring is the detail I wanted to build the character around, so the blue face paint repeats its color on her eyes and neck. She looks back over her shoulder, as if someone called her name. The orange scarf and the golden dunes are warm, and the blue marks stand against them. Her braids on the side are drawn with care.
characters/images/50_Desert-princess.web.craft: Digital painting · blue against orange and gold · braided hair detail · desert backdrop

characters/images/51_Blacky-purple-hair..title: Blacky Portrait Sketch
characters/images/51_Blacky-purple-hair..alt: Sketch of a girl with short burgundy locs and green eyes, head tilted up with a cheeky smile, fluffy white collar
characters/images/51_Blacky-purple-hair..tooltip: She looks up with a smirk, as if she just heard something she wanted to hear.
characters/images/51_Blacky-purple-hair..description: Chin up, eyes sliding sideways, mouth half open in a smirk: the whole sketch hangs on her attitude. Deep burgundy hair and green eyes play against the warm brown skin. Below the neck I only suggested the fluffy collar in a few light strokes and stopped there.
characters/images/51_Blacky-purple-hair..craft: Digital sketch · loose pencil texture · burgundy hair and green eyes · white background

environments/images/002-Medina-backgroun.title: Medina Archway Alley
environments/images/002-Medina-backgroun.alt: Painted medina alley with a brick arch, teal awnings, a vine-wrapped lantern and stone steps over blue-patterned paving
environments/images/002-Medina-backgroun.tooltip: A tiny figure waits at the far end of the arch, where the street turns to light.
environments/images/002-Medina-backgroun.description: Warm orange walls against cold teal trim: the whole alley hangs on that clash. I ran a blue patterned strip along the paving and under the arch, and put a small lit figure far down the passage for scale. The plaster is chipped and stained, because a clean medina would look fake to me.
environments/images/002-Medina-backgroun.craft: Digital painting · orange vs teal · blue floor guiding line · weathered plaster

environments/images/03_Medina-Zanka.webp.title: Medina Zanka Sketch
environments/images/03_Medina-Zanka.webp.alt: Ink and watercolor sketch of a narrow medina lane with an arched passage, a tall tower and a large wooden door
environments/images/03_Medina-Zanka.webp.tooltip: A narrow medina lane bends toward a tall tower, past a heavy wooden door.
environments/images/03_Medina-Zanka.webp.description: Zanka is a lane I wanted to remember, so I went in with pen first and added thin washes of peach and grey afterward. The wide-angle bend pushes the door forward and leans the walls toward the tower. In places I left the paper warm and bare. A sketch should look like a sketch.
environments/images/03_Medina-Zanka.webp.craft: Ink linework · watercolor washes · fisheye distortion · sketchbook paper

environments/images/04_Background-Art.we.title: Cobbled Lane Arches
environments/images/04_Background-Art.we.alt: Painted fisheye view of a sunlit cobblestone lane with iron wall lanterns and a stone arch on the right
environments/images/04_Background-Art.we.tooltip: Midday heat bakes an empty stone lane, and only the iron lanterns wait for dusk.
environments/images/04_Background-Art.we.description: I pushed the cast shadow on the left wall toward violet, which makes the sunlit yellow stone burn warmer beside it. Cobbles took the longest. I laid in light and dark patches first and added the joints last, otherwise they turn into wallpaper. The curved edges come from a fisheye frame, the kind a wide background shot might need.
environments/images/04_Background-Art.we.craft: Digital painting · fisheye perspective · purple shadow vs yellow stone · cobble patterning

environments/images/05_Medina-Background.title: Carved Door in Morning Light
environments/images/05_Medina-Background.alt: Tall painted medina street with a carved wooden door, an arch over the lane, orange blossoms and light rays from above
environments/images/05_Medina-Background.tooltip: Light spills down a quiet lane and settles on one carved door.
environments/images/05_Medina-Background.description: Soft rays come down the left wall and leave a pink cast across the cobbles. I put my tightest detail into the carved wooden door and let the plaster and arches around it stay loose and slightly blurred. Orange blossoms hang in from the right, a warm patch against the cool sky.
environments/images/05_Medina-Background.craft: Digital painting · light rays · visible pencil lines · carved door focal point

environments/images/06_Mountain-City.web.title: Mountain City
environments/images/06_Mountain-City.web.alt: Painted desert scene of a white walled city on a rock plateau under a big cloud, with a small flying saucer above
environments/images/06_Mountain-City.web.tooltip: A small city clings to a cliff under a heavy cloud, and something odd hovers above it.
environments/images/06_Mountain-City.web.description: A city sits on a ledge of red rock, and a cloud caps the peak like a lid. I painted the buildings pale so they separate from the brick-red cliff, then tethered a small saucer near the top as a strange little detail. In front, I left a wide soft dune with almost no marks before the rock starts to climb.
environments/images/06_Mountain-City.web.craft: Digital painting · saturated blue sky · pale city on red rock · soft dunes

environments/images/07_Interior-Castle-0.title: Castle Courtyard Interior
environments/images/07_Interior-Castle-0.alt: Painted courtyard with colored flags, a stone footbridge over water and dark foreground silhouettes
environments/images/07_Interior-Castle-0.tooltip: Colored flags hang over a quiet courtyard bridge, seen from the shadows.
environments/images/07_Interior-Castle-0.description: I cut the foreground down to near-black shapes, antlers, columns and rails, so the courtyard shows through them like a peephole. Beyond that screen the color opens up into pink walls, blue water and flags in red, green and yellow. I set the small stone bridge in the middle of the frame and left it there.
environments/images/07_Interior-Castle-0.craft: Digital painting · dark foreground silhouettes · pastel mid-ground · flag color accents

environments/images/08_Outdoor-Building..title: Rooftop Building View
environments/images/08_Outdoor-Building..alt: Sketch-style painting of an old corner building seen from above, with a weedy flat roof, orange tiles and ivy
environments/images/08_Outdoor-Building..tooltip: Weeds have taken over the flat roof of this old corner building.
environments/images/08_Outdoor-Building..description: I took the camera above the roofline because looking down is the quickest way to read a building volumes. The roof has patches of weeds, a few pipes and one orange tiled corner. My linework stays visible and the color is thin. This is a study of how the place is built, not a final render.
environments/images/08_Outdoor-Building..craft: Line and wash · high angle · muted greys with orange tile accents · loose color

environments/images/09_siquela-sitting-o.title: Siquela on the Stairs
environments/images/09_siquela-sitting-o.alt: Girl with long red hair in a yellow dress sitting on pale stone steps with a black cat on a pillar, purple blossoms above
environments/images/09_siquela-sitting-o.tooltip: Siquela has company on the steps: a black cat watching from the wall.
environments/images/09_siquela-sitting-o.description: Siquela rests her chin on her hand and looks off to the side, in no hurry at all. Perched on the stone pillar beside her, the black cat is the darkest note in an otherwise pale, sun-washed stairway. I pushed the stone and the light to soft tones and let her yellow dress and the purple blossoms carry the color.
environments/images/09_siquela-sitting-o.craft: Digital painting · soft light · yellow dress vs pale stone · blurred blossoms in front

environments/images/10-Enviro-Fisheye-Me.title: Flying Medina Street
environments/images/10-Enviro-Fisheye-Me.alt: Illustrated medina street full of people on hover bikes and a flying pod, with a glass tower on the right
environments/images/10-Enviro-Fisheye-Me.tooltip: Everyone on this street has somewhere to be, and most of them are flying.
environments/images/10-Enviro-Fisheye-Me.description: A lot is going on in this one: a baker hands bread across from a floating cart, two musicians sit in an arched window, and riders weave past on hover bikes. The tall glass tower on the right is big and dark, a calm counterweight to the crowded middle. Placing the little stories in the windows was my favorite part.
environments/images/10-Enviro-Fisheye-Me.craft: Digital illustration · fisheye wide shot · many small stories · dark frame vs warm center

environments/images/11-Medina-Background.title: Minaret and Birds
environments/images/11-Medina-Background.alt: Tall vertical painting of a mosque minaret with a green roof and a tree, flock of birds crossing a blue sky
environments/images/11-Medina-Background.tooltip: Birds wheel past an old green-tiled minaret and its leaning tree.
environments/images/11-Medina-Background.description: Giving most of this tall canvas to open sky let me run a loose diagonal of birds down toward the minaret and its crooked tree. I saved my crisp brushwork for the tower and the green roof tiles, and left the clouds soft. A small blue shop sign sits at the bottom edge, a reminder of the street far below.
environments/images/11-Medina-Background.craft: Digital painting · tall format · soft clouds · sharp architectural detail

environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.title: Night Tree House
environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.alt: Vertical night painting of a domed building on a twisted tree in a desert, with clouds, stars and one bright star
environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.tooltip: A small domed house sits on a tree that looks older than the desert.
environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.project: Environment concept · desert fantasy at night
environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.description: A house on a tree is pure fantasy, so the roots had to look old enough to carry it. I painted the sky dark and cool, then gave the single bright star its own flare, as if it were the lamp for the house. Soft low clouds hide where the ground ends.
environments/images/12_One-House-in-dese.craft: Digital painting · night palette · warm tree vs cold sky · glowing star

environments/images/13_Bar_Scene_Backgro.title: Bar Counter Scene
environments/images/13_Bar_Scene_Backgro.alt: Inked and colored view from a stool of a bar counter, with a hanging lamp, shelves of bottles, a sink and a fan
environments/images/13_Bar_Scene_Backgro.tooltip: One bare bulb over an old counter, with the stools waiting in the dark.
environments/images/13_Bar_Scene_Backgro.description: One bulb lights the whole counter, and everything outside its cone falls away into dark ink lines. I crowded the shelf with bottles, a brass pipe and stacked cups, because a bar this old never has an empty shelf. The wide, curved lens pulls the stools close, as if I had just sat down.
environments/images/13_Bar_Scene_Backgro.craft: Ink linework with color · lamp cone of light · wide-angle lens · warm wood tones

environments/images/14_Backgorund-Art-Di.title: Dihya Climb Canyon
environments/images/14_Backgorund-Art-Di.alt: Dark painted canyon from above with a sunlit crack of orange rock and glowing spider-like marks on the walls
environments/images/14_Backgorund-Art-Di.tooltip: A strip of light at the top of a canyon, and odd marks glowing on the walls.
environments/images/14_Backgorund-Art-Di.description: This canyon is the backdrop for the Dihya climb, so it had to feel tall and a little dangerous. Most of the rock stays close to black, with one thin strip of light running down it like a path. I added the pale radial marks on the walls to make the place feel not quite natural.
environments/images/14_Backgorund-Art-Di.craft: Digital painting · near-black rock · single light strip · glowing wall details

environments/images/15_Background-Art-Th.title: The Lion Den
environments/images/15_Background-Art-Th.alt: Painted cave with a keyhole-shaped doorway in a brick wall, a stream of water through the sand and light pouring in at right
environments/images/15_Background-Art-Th.tooltip: A keyhole door half buried in sand, and a stream that runs out toward you.
environments/images/15_Background-Art-Th.description: Half buried under the cave rock is a brick wall with a keyhole door, a quiet hint that someone once lived here. I brought warm light in from the right and let it graze the sand and the bricks. The stream winds from the doorway to the lower left, linking the dark interior to the foreground.
environments/images/15_Background-Art-Th.craft: Digital painting · warm cave light · curving stream · keyhole door focal point

environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.title: Ounaymir and Hourya Reunion
environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.alt: Cartoon-style garden with a boy in white trousers walking a stone path toward a girl in a light blue dress, palace behind
environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.tooltip: He is walking up the garden path toward someone he has not seen in a long time.
environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.project: Background and characters · Ounaymir and Hourya
environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.description: Ounaymir walks the stone path and Hourya waits near the flowers in a pale blue dress. I pushed the palace far back so the two of them carry the scene, and framed the foreground with big dark leaves. Clean outlines and flat greens keep the garden light and easy to read.
environments/images/16-Ounaymir-Hourya-R.craft: Digital illustration · clean outlines · dark leaf frame · small figures, big garden

storyboard/images/01_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.title: Jogger and Falcon
storyboard/images/01_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.alt: Storyboard frame of a woman in a pink top jogging down an empty road, a falcon above handing off a water bottle
storyboard/images/01_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.tooltip: A jogger on an empty road between skyscrapers, and a falcon dropping her a bottle.
storyboard/images/01_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.description: Cloud-wrapped towers on both sides and an empty road running to the horizon give my jogger plenty of room. High above her I placed a falcon dropping off a water bottle, a playful beat that stays clear against the sky. Her pink top cuts across the cool blue street.
storyboard/images/01_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.craft: Digital storyboard painting · one-point perspective · pink vs blue · low clouds

storyboard/images/02_Epic-Action.webp.title: Rifle on the Shoulder
storyboard/images/02_Epic-Action.webp.alt: Storyboard frame of a man in a dark tank top with a bloodied chest, a long rifle over his shoulder in blue light
storyboard/images/02_Epic-Action.webp.tooltip: He has finished the fight, but he is not done with the day.
storyboard/images/02_Epic-Action.webp.description: I went for the aftermath here, not the shot itself. He stands with the rifle on his shoulder and his eyes half closed, and a thin line of smoke rises from the barrel. I washed the frame in cold blue so the bloodstain across his shirt hits harder.
storyboard/images/02_Epic-Action.webp.craft: Digital painting · cold blue palette · single red accent · diagonal light shaft

storyboard/images/03_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.title: Morning Runner
storyboard/images/03_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.alt: Storyboard frame of a shirtless runner in dark shorts and black running shoes on a pale path, hazy hills behind
storyboard/images/03_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.tooltip: A runner passes the camera in soft morning grey.
storyboard/images/03_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.description: Framed vertically, the runner is caught mid-stride in front of a calm, misty wash of wide brush strokes. I left the hills pale behind him and let the warm skin and dark shorts carry the frame. His stride is loose and forward-leaning, an easy mile rather than a sprint.
storyboard/images/03_Ad_Running-Jogger.w.craft: Digital painting · vertical format · muted lavender background · warm skin vs cool grey

storyboard/images/04_Ad_Swimmers.webp.title: Underwater Swimmer
storyboard/images/04_Ad_Swimmers.webp.alt: Storyboard frame of a swimmer in a white cap and goggles breaking the surface in a pool, arms spread wide, lane lines behind
storyboard/images/04_Ad_Swimmers.webp.tooltip: First breath at the surface as his stroke breaks the calm between the lane lines.
storyboard/images/04_Ad_Swimmers.webp.description: Dropping the camera right onto the waterline let me bend the lane lines around him and spread the splash ring behind his cap. His arms reach wide across the frame at the peak of the stroke. Against all that pool blue I used warm skin tones and crisp white foam.
storyboard/images/04_Ad_Swimmers.webp.craft: Digital painting · waterline view · blue palette · bubbles and splash detail

storyboard/images/05_Ad-Beautiul-Glancin.title: Glasses Glance
storyboard/images/05_Ad-Beautiul-Glancin.alt: Black and white storyboard frame of a freckled young woman with wavy hair pushing round glasses up, sparkles around her
storyboard/images/05_Ad-Beautiul-Glancin.tooltip: She lifts her glasses and gives the camera a look.
storyboard/images/05_Ad-Beautiul-Glancin.description: Her fingertips on the round glasses and the scattered sparkles set up the beat, and the expression finishes it: one lifted brow, a faint half smile, freckles across the cheeks. I worked in grayscale to lock pose, lighting and crop before touching any color.
storyboard/images/05_Ad-Beautiul-Glancin.craft: Grayscale digital painting · bokeh circles · light rays · freckle detail

storyboard/images/06_smirky-face.webp.title: Smirk in the Light
storyboard/images/06_smirky-face.webp.alt: Grayscale portrait of a dark-haired man with a sly smile in a high collar, half his face crossed by a band of shadow
storyboard/images/06_smirky-face.webp.tooltip: Half his face sits in shadow, and the smirk is the part he lets us see.
storyboard/images/06_smirky-face.webp.description: I sliced a hard band of shadow diagonally across his face and left a single eye lit above the sly half smile. Behind his high collar the background drops into soft grayscale blobs. It is a tight storyboard beat for the moment a villain quietly shows his hand.
storyboard/images/06_smirky-face.webp.craft: Grayscale digital painting · diagonal shadow band · soft bokeh · expression close-up

storyboard/images/07_Arrow-shooting.webp.title: Arrow Release
storyboard/images/07_Arrow-shooting.webp.alt: Grayscale storyboard frame of an archer's drawn bow and a flying arrow with motion streaks, seen from behind the arm
storyboard/images/07_Arrow-shooting.webp.tooltip: The string lets go and the arrow is already leaving the frame.
storyboard/images/07_Arrow-shooting.webp.description: I parked the camera right behind the drawing arm, so the release happens in front of you as the arrow streaks off to the left. Horizontal smears trail the shaft to suggest speed without a single motion line. Rough gray strokes on the sleeve keep the beat spare.
storyboard/images/07_Arrow-shooting.webp.craft: Grayscale marker-style painting · behind-the-arm angle · motion streaks · loose strokes

storyboard/images/08_Food-Delivery.webp.title: Grocery Delivery Smile
storyboard/images/08_Food-Delivery.webp.alt: Storyboard frame of a smiling delivery man in a blue cap and red shirt holding a grocery bag, a red tag reading COSCO
storyboard/images/08_Food-Delivery.webp.tooltip: Fresh bread, greens and a grin at the door.
storyboard/images/08_Food-Delivery.webp.description: My delivery man holds up a bag packed with a baguette, corn, greens and a bottle of milk. On the right I placed the big red tag with the store name, where a title or logo would sit in a commercial. His blue cap and red shirt stand out against the warm cream background.
storyboard/images/08_Food-Delivery.webp.craft: Digital painting · warm cream background · red tag shape · bright, friendly color

storyboard/images/09_Man-splashing-water.title: Water over the Head
storyboard/images/09_Man-splashing-water.alt: Storyboard frame of a man in a vest pouring water from a green bottle over his face, with a blurred bright background
storyboard/images/09_Man-splashing-water.tooltip: He tips the bottle over his head and the heat finally breaks.
storyboard/images/09_Man-splashing-water.description: The best moment of a hard run is that first splash, so I moved in close on his face and the bottle. The water runs down his cheek and chin in a few quick lines. Behind him, I blurred cool tones into soft patches and left the wet skin crisp.
storyboard/images/09_Man-splashing-water.craft: Digital painting · close framing · cool blurred background · water streaks

storyboard/images/10_Jumping_to_action.w.title: Leap into the Fight
storyboard/images/10_Jumping_to_action.w.alt: Grayscale storyboard frame of a shirtless fighter jumping with arms behind his head and a sword strapped to his back
storyboard/images/10_Jumping_to_action.w.tooltip: Mid-air, mouth open, with a sword strapped to his back and nothing under his feet.
storyboard/images/10_Jumping_to_action.w.description: I drew him at the top of the jump, hands behind his head, yelling before he lands. The strapped sword and the loose sash turn an unarmed-looking leap into the start of a brawl. Behind him, a gray textured background with splatter on the right leaves the figure clean.
storyboard/images/10_Jumping_to_action.w.craft: Grayscale painting · mid-air pose · paper texture · dark splatter

storyboard/images/11_Facing-Cougar-Knife.title: Cougar Standoff
storyboard/images/11_Facing-Cougar-Knife.alt: Grayscale storyboard of a man with a knife behind his back, hand out, facing a cougar between boulders in a rocky pass
storyboard/images/11_Facing-Cougar-Knife.tooltip: Open hand, hidden knife, and a cougar that has not decided yet.
storyboard/images/11_Facing-Cougar-Knife.description: He holds one hand out to calm the animal and keeps the knife behind his back. I staged the shot over his shoulder, so all the tension sits in his posture instead of his face. Between two boulders ahead of him, the cougar steps down and stares straight back.
storyboard/images/11_Facing-Cougar-Knife.craft: Grayscale wash painting · rocky canyon · over-the-shoulder view · animal anatomy

storyboard/images/12-.webp.title: Kneeling with the Shotgun
storyboard/images/12-.webp.alt: Grayscale storyboard frame of a woman kneeling with a shotgun in a smoky corridor, light rays pointing toward her
storyboard/images/12-.webp.tooltip: Calm in the corridor smoke with a shotgun across her knee, while a hand reaches in above.
storyboard/images/12-.webp.description: She crouches calmly with smoke piling up behind her, and the stillness is the point. I angled the floor lines and the shafts of light to lock her kneeling shape into the middle of the corridor. A hand reaches in from the top of the frame, and I left it unexplained for the story to decide.
storyboard/images/12-.webp.craft: Grayscale digital painting · converging light rays · smoke clouds · central figure

storyboard/images/13_Sketch-2024-06-14-1.title: Rooftop Lookout

storyboard/images/13_Sketch-2024-06-14-1.tooltip: Perched on the roof edge in goggles, watching the street below.
storyboard/images/13_Sketch-2024-06-14-1.description: Shot from high behind the ledge, a figure in goggles and a hoodie squats on the roof edge and watches the flag-strung street below. storyboard/images/13_Sketch-2024-06-14-1.craft: Grayscale sketch · high angle · flat gray planes · light pencil grid

storyboard/images/14_Bike-Repair-Shot.we.title: Bike Repair Shot

storyboard/images/14_Bike-Repair-Shot.we.tooltip: A quick spray at the pedal, and the whole bike is ready to ride.

storyboard/images/15_Sketch-2020-11-2471.title: Woman at the Window

storyboard/images/15_Sketch-2020-11-2471.tooltip: She looks past the window, and whatever she sees has not gone well.

storyboard/images/16_Sketch-2021-10-1939.title: Parkour Vault

storyboard/images/17_astro_soldier-pad.w.title: Astro Soldier Close-Up
